heading: A Broken Crown
intro: The Starcrown that kept Ardenmoor whole has been broken in eight pieces, and the pale tyrant Ghaldur holds the Hollow Peak and the princess Ismera in it. You come out of the meadow with nothing in your hands. An old man in the cave by the path says it is dangerous to go alone.

objectives.instruction: Find the old man in the cave and take what he offers
Find the first dungeon and bring out the first shard of the Starcrown
